ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark grey/black) with a low white-to-black pixel ratio estimated at 0.05:0.95 across the visible fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous low-intensity field; high-intensity (white) contiguous pixel clusters are isolated at the distal tips. Sparse, sub-5-pixel focal spots are distributed across the mid-span of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an internal pixel angle of approximately 50 degrees; notch depth constitutes roughly 15% of the visible vertical fluke span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations; irregular peaks and valleys ranging from 5 to 20 pixels in depth are continuous along the trailing edge from the notch to the tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve along the upper distal edges transitioning into a tapered, semi-acute sweep at the lateral extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-contrast white pixel clusters (approximately 15-40 pixels in diameter) concentrated on the far-left and far-right distal tips.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular scarring and suspected barnacle encrustations on the trailing edge tips, visible as high-intensity white textural disruptions.
